description: Talk to Tada like a QA teammate. Say what to check and I start at once and answer with the verdict, the points that held, and the report link. Send the `thread` back for a follow-up, a question, or (with no message) how the check is going. An app on localhost is reached through a tunnel.

account.description: Who is signed in, as a role in the app's own word ("admin"). about_app lists the test accounts.

app.description: The app, as "owner/name". Left out, the workspace's only app, or the thread's app.

environment.description: Where to check: "staging", "production", or an address. Left out, the app's usual address.

message.description: What you want, in plain words: what to check ("Check that a new customer can sign up"), a follow-up ("also on a phone", "check it again"), or a question ("why did point 3 not hold?"). Leave it out with `thread` to read how the check is going.

new_account.description: true: check as a brand-new account that signs up, instead of a saved one.

thread.description: The thread an earlier answer gave. Send it to carry on with that check: a follow-up, a question, or (with no message) a progress read. Use the newest thread you were given.

name: ask_tada
